answer: Northwind Logistics reported FY2025 revenue of $412.6 million, up 8.4% year over year [S1]. Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded to 21.5% [S1]. Customer retention is 97% [S4]. sources.title: Northwind Logistics 10-K excerpt
sources.text: Northwind Logistics 10-K excerpt. FY2025 revenue was $412.6 million, up 8.4% year over year. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 17.2%. The company operates 38 distribution centers across North America.

sources.title: Credit agreement summary
sources.text: The term loan of $150 million matures in March 2029 and carries a leverage covenant of 4.0x net debt to EBITDA.

sources.title: Management presentation
sources.text: Management expects low- to mid-single-digit organic growth in FY2026, subject to freight volume recovery.
